description: Resume a PAUSED or HALTED crew from its last checkpoint: the same action as the Console's Resume button. The crew continues where it stopped, so one whose Engineer declared itself blocked runs the Engineer again, reading the messages queued for it while halted. To send an open pull request to review without an Engineer round, use anyforge_resume_crew_with_pr. Pass `guidance` for "Resume with guidance": the Engineer's first resumed round runs with that text and the queued messages, in this one call. On a crew halted at its ship gate, guidance is that gate's amend (refused like anyforge_amend_crew). A crew the guidance cannot reach is refused with not_resumable and the guidance is not stored: one that is not paused or halted, or one paused at a gate; use anyforge_amend_crew there. Requires `approve` scope.

guidance.description: Optional guidance for the Engineer, up to 4000 characters. Omit to resume as before.

name: anyforge_resume_crew
title: Resume crew
